verdict.rationale: Phoenix's first-party docs state that it accepts traces over the OpenTelemetry protocol (OTLP), is built on top of OpenTelemetry, and uses OpenInference instrumentation, so apps send standard OTel traces rather than a proprietary format. Auto-instrumentation covers frameworks such as LlamaIndex, LangChain, DSPy, Mastra and the Vercel AI SDK. Missing for 10: details of the OTLP endpoint and transport (gRPC/HTTP), any evidence of exporting or forwarding traces out over OTLP, and independent or hands-on confirmation of OTLP ingestion.
